I'm an engineering student at Harvey Mudd College. I like working where hardware and software meet: designing digital logic, figuring out how processors work, and writing the low-level code that brings a board to life.

## What I Study

::: {.grid .interest-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .interest-card}
#### Computer Architecture

How processors are built and what makes them fast. For my System-on-Chip Design final project, my partner and I turned a single-cycle RISC-V core into a 5-stage pipelined processor and optimized it for speed and area.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .interest-card}
#### Design & Verification

Writing SystemVerilog and proving it works with simulation, compliance tests, and benchmarks. As a Clay-Wolkin Research Fellow, I wrote certification tests for the RISC-V Sdtrig debug extension.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .interest-card}
#### Embedded Systems

Register-level microcontroller programming and real peripherals. In E155, I've used an iCE40 FPGA and an STM32L432KC to build keypad scanners, digital audio, and a Wi-Fi temperature monitor.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .interest-card}
#### Industry Hardware

At TRL11, I worked on space-qualified networking hardware.
:::

:::
